我们对 [System.GetName] 恒星系中空间站进行调查的期间，团队无意中导致船体的一部分区段失去完整性，引起了爆炸性减压。

一瞬间，几个[Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural]被卷入了裂口，直接导致他们死亡。幸运的是，[Root.GetLeaderName]当时在空间站的不同区段，但这对调查工作来说仍是一个重大挫折。
texts.en:
During our survey of the station in the [System.GetName] system, our team inadvertently caused a section of the hull to lose integrity, triggering an explosive decompression.

Within moments, several [Root.Owner.GetArchaeologistPlural] were swept through the breach to their deaths. Fortunately, [Root.GetLeaderName] was in a different section of the station at the time, but this is nevertheless a significant setback for the investigation effort.
